text:
First time in Kyoto? Most people pick a hotel for the view, then spend their trip queuing for buses. Base yourself near the train lines instead: from Shijo-Karasuma, Kyoto Station is 3 minutes away by subway 👇

🤔 Guess first, then check the answer 👉 https://japanbystation.com/kyoto-where-to-stay-first-trip

We checked every route on a December weekday and every price against Kyoto City's own transport and tourism sites.

🚇 SHIJO-KARASUMA (our pick)

1️⃣ The Karasuma subway and the Hankyu line cross here. Kyoto Station 3 minutes (¥220), Kawaramachi one stop, Arashiyama about 27 minutes (¥240).

🚄 KYOTO STATION

2️⃣ Best for JR day trips and late arrivals. Fushimi Inari is 6 minutes (¥150), Saga-Arashiyama 17 minutes. The tourism office says big hotels here are easier to find in peak season.

🏮 KAWARAMACHI / GION

3️⃣ Walk out at dusk into old Kyoto. Keihan trains reach Fushimi-Inari in 8 minutes. The lodging here is mostly long-standing ryokan and luxury hotels, so there are fewer budget rooms.

🚌 ABOUT THE BUSES

A bus is a flat ¥230, but Kyoto's tourism site warns that routes like the 205 and 206 get very crowded in season.

💬 OUR TAKE

Karasuma for a 3–4 night first trip. Kyoto Station if most days are day trips. Gion if this is the special-occasion trip.
